MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The audio and HDMI cables fit my pattern of buying practical accessories to connect and maintain electronics, although neither meets a clear need right now.",
    "Recommending useful accessories made sense given my repeated purchases of cables, mounts, memory cards, and storage cases."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The iPad case, Lightning cable, and Galaxy Buds case require specific devices I have not shown that I own; my known tablet is a Fire 7 and my previous Apple cable used 30-pin.",
    "Security cameras, paddleboard speakers, and car speakers suggest new projects or activities that my camera accessories and car mounts do not establish.",
    "The 25-foot audio cables and advanced HDMI cable offer capabilities I have no clear use for with my known equipment."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying electronics accessories seemed to be treated as interest in almost any electronics product, even when its purpose was quite different.",
    "My tablet, camera, and car accessory purchases seemed to imply interest in accessories for other devices or larger upgrades."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Exact device and connector compatibility matters: a useful accessory needs to fit equipment I actually have.",
    "My purchases often solve specific practical needs, so cable length, intended use, and whether the features suit my existing equipment matter more than a broad resemblance.",
    "Repeated memory-card, tripod, and storage purchases give clearer evidence of ongoing needs than purchases that would require assuming a new hobby or installation project."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my interest in practical electronics accessories but often missed the specific equipment and immediate purpose that make them useful to me."
}
